site.heading: Every meeting, meal and event. One order.
site.lead: Bibi is the booking system for venues without a hotel system. Create an order in one step, let the customer pay through a link, and send the kitchen a run sheet that is always up to date.

hero.badge: Bookings, food and drink for venues

audience.label: Built for venues without a hotel system

steps.title: From first request to finished event in three steps

create.title: Create the order
create.body: Staff add rooms, food and activities in one step. No quote for smaller meetings.

pay.title: The customer pays
pay.body: A link for card payment, or an invoice. The customer never needs to use the app.

serve.title: The kitchen knows
serve.body: Needs are counted, run sheets reach the person responsible, and every change makes a new version.

features.title: Everything a venue needs, nothing it does not

orders.title: Create an order in one step
orders.body: Pick a predefined order for a smaller meeting and Bibi fills in the rooms, food and activities. No quote, no back and forth. The customer pays by card or on invoice through a link.

needs.title: Allergens counted, guests never tracked
needs.body: Count needs against your own lists, such as the 14 EU allergens. Bibi matches them to items and compiles them for the kitchen. No personal data about guests.

runSheets.title: Run sheets that reach the right person
runSheets.body: Versioned run sheets, such as the kitchen order, go to the person responsible. Export them as pdf, csv or json when you need to hand over outside the system.

holds.title: Know what is held, and until when
holds.body: Soft holds carry a held-since date and an expiry. Hard holds block the room. Every order moves through the statuses you define.

setup.title: Bibi adapts to your venue
setup.body: You decide the types, fields, lists, statuses and responsibilities. Access follows three roles that you fine-tune per person.

assistant.title: Ask. Review. Approve.
assistant.body: The assistant works inside Bibi as you. It proposes a change, and nothing happens until you confirm. Every change is logged.

integrations.title: Fits the tools you already use
integrations.sie: SIE 4I export for any accounting system

cta.title: Run your venue from one place
cta.body: Set up your venue in minutes, then invite your team.

assistant.user: Create a lunch for 24 on Friday in the Salon
assistant.reply: I can create this order. Review it before I do.

site.metaTitle: Bibi – the app for your organisation's daily operation
site.metaDescription: Bibi is an app that helps organisations handle their daily operation: bookings, rooms, food and drink, activities and payments in one place.
